NBA DFS Rankings for Wednesday, October 21 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, October 21 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 21, 4:59 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) ranks first on the Wednesday, October 21 DraftKings main slate at 59.6 projected DraftKings points for $11,000. Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA, 56.2) and Jalen Johnson (ATL, 49.0) are next.

The table ranks the top 100 of 165 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 21, 4:59 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
